items.title: Public comments
Approval of the minutes of the meeting of the Board of Directors held on September 22, 2026

Bookkeeper's Report, including (i) financial and investment reports, and authorizing the payment of invoices presented, and (ii) status of compliance by the District with Texas Government Code, Chapter 2265, relative to energy reporting
Annual review of Order Establishing Policy for Investment of District Funds and appointing Investment Officer, and adoption of Resolution in connection therewith
Adoption of Resolution Adopting List of Qualified Brokers Authorized to Engage in Investment Transactions with the District
Preparation and filing of continuing disclosure report for fiscal year ended May 31, 2026 (due November 30, 2026)
Receive Tax Assessor-Collector report and approve payment of invoices presented and moving of accounts to uncollectible roll
Report on legal action taken by the District's delinquent tax collections attorney, authorize foreclosure proceedings, installment agreements, and the filing of proofs of claim
Conduct a public hearing regarding the adoption of the District's 2026 tax rate
Levy of the District's 2026 maintenance tax rate, and the adoption of an Order in connection therewith
Approval and execution of an Amendment to the Seventh Amended and Restated District Information Form
Operator's Report
items.description:
a) Monthly report, including inspections, repairs and maintenance of District facilities and status of compliance with permits; and
b) Communications with Bridgeland municipal utility districts regarding water and wastewater services provided by the District;

items.title: Engineer's Report
Review and discuss Capital Improvement Plan and authorize action in connection therewith
Report on status of storm water pollution prevention and storm water quality management; including status of storm water permits and the taking of any action relative thereto
Status of ninth application with the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality requesting approval of Master District facilities purchase

Review and approval of agreed upon procedures and authorize payment to Prologis, LP for facilities constructed on behalf of the District with proceeds from the District's Unlimited Tax Road Bonds, Series 2026

Review and approval of agreed upon procedures and authorize payment to Bridgeland Development, LP for Master Facilities with proceeds from the Harris County Municipal Utility District No. 419 and Harris County Municipal Utility District No. 491 Connection Charges
Matters related to the Bridgeland Water Agency (the "Agency") and directives to the District's Trustee and Alternate(s)
Receive monthly Communications Report relative to the District's website by Touchstone District Services, LLC
Developer's Report
Annexation of certain land into the boundaries of the District, including proposed annexation of approximately 82.90 acres as requested by Bridgeland Development, L.P
Attorney's Report, including presentation of Notice of Second Reservation of Capacity by Master District
Schedule of future meetings and matters for possible placement on future agendas
